command: set -euo pipefail; .venv/bin/pre-commit run --all-files; .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q -m 'not hardware'; bash scripts/check_schema.sh; cmake -S test/host -B build/host-tests; cmake --build build/host-tests --parallel; ctest --test-dir build/host-tests --output-on-failure; bash scripts/run_clang_tidy_host.sh; git diff --check; if ! git diff --quiet; then git add -- .pre-commit-config.yaml tools/schema/generate_climate_contract.py lib/environment_control/src/climate test/test_climate_v6 tests/test_climate_contract_codegen.py tests/test_mvp_contract_v6.py test/host/CMakeLists.txt scripts/check_schema.sh scripts/run_clang_tidy_host.sh docs/MVP_ENVIRONMENT_CONTROLLER.md; git diff --cached --check; git commit -m 'Harden climate v6 quality gates'; git push origin HEAD:mvp/environment-controller; fi
